[[File:Hydrix dragon icon.png|left]]
'''Hydrix dragons''' are high-level [[Slayer]] monsters requiring level 101 Slayer to kill. They are part of the [[Gemstone dragons|gemstone dragon]] group, and are the strongest dragon of this type.

A total of six hydrix dragons are located in the [[gemstone cavern]] under the [[Shilo Village mine]]. They require the completion of the [[Karamja achievements#Hard achievements|hard Karamja achievements]] in order to access them in the gemstone cavern underneath. In order to pass the barrier to confront them, players are also required to sacrifice a number of [[uncut dragonstone]], [[uncut onyx]], or [[uncut hydrix]] gems—with each gem type allowing the player to kill a certain number of dragons within their respective chamber, up to a limit of storing 60,000 kills at a time.

If the player is on a gemstone dragon Slayer task, charges are neither needed nor consumed.

===Getting there===
The [[gemstone cavern]] is located inside the gem mine in the northern-western part of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] on [[Karamja]]. To be able to enter the cave players must have completed the [[hard Karamja achievements]]. To access the mine players can teleport directly to the gem mine with the option in the [[Karamja gloves 3]] or [[Karamja gloves 4|4]]. 

Hydrix dragons can also be found in the [[Wilderness]], near the [[Wilderness (level 47) Lava Maze mine|Lava Maze mine]] and in the [[Deep Wilderness Dungeon]].

==Strategies==
Hydrix dragons attack primarily with magic, although they will use both magic and melee if within melee range in addition to the regular dragon fire attack.

Hydrix dragons have a special attack in which they send a row of spikes towards the area that the player is currently standing on. After a short delay, there is a three-by-three [[game square]] area where spikes appear, dealing magic damage and draining all adrenaline while also applying a debuff where adrenaline gained is reduced to half for 15 seconds. However, they will not use this special attack if the player remains within melee distance of them.

Hydrix dragons have quite high [[Defence]], so players may wish to use a accuracy-boosting  [[nihil familiar]] to ensure that they have a good accuracy against these dragons.

[[Devotion]] in conjunction with [[Protect from Magic|Protect]] or [[Deflect Magic]] does block all damage done by the special attack, but it does not block the adrenaline loss nor does it prevent the debuff from occurring. While one may also use [[Resonance]] to heal from the attack, due to the debuff still occurring and its crippling nature, one should dodge it instead.

It is possible to kill hydrix dragons with an [[aggression potion]] active and while not paying attention to the possible special attacks rather safely by placing a hydrix dragon soul in their own [[Sunken Pyramid#Slayer Dungeon|Slayer dungeon]] and standing on top of the dragon's spawn point. This makes it likely that the dragon targets the player before it gets out of melee distance, and thus prevents it from using its special attacks. Players can also use the [[Deep Wilderness Dungeon]] as there are two spawns and [[cannons]] can be placed, allowing players to get upwards of 1,000,000 [[experience]] per hour in [[Slayer]] there.

Hydrix dragons are also a good monster to use [[scrimshaw of sacrifice]] on, due to its sizeable combat and slayer experience and a low-value drop table.

==Trivia== 
* It was the first monster to have a static Slayer level requirement above 99.
* Upon release, the highest possible Slayer level was still 99, thus meaning one would've needed to utilise boosts to be allowed to kill them no matter what level they were. [[Wilder pie]]s were released alongside the gemstone dragon update to ensure players could get consistent kills without having to reboost.
* The experience rates were buffed a few months after release due to player complaints.
